content.description: Durable memory content to store. Keep it concise and factual.

scope.description: Use project for this project only. Use global for cross-project user preferences or standing instructions.

kind.description: Short category such as preference, decision, fact, instruction, credential-note, or workflow.

tags.description: Optional short lowercase tags for filtering and review.

confidence.description: Confidence that this memory should be reused later. Defaults to 1.

pinned.description: Whether this memory should be preferred in fallback context.
